summary.headline: Wisconsin gas averages $3.62/gal
summary.blurb: Regular gas is averaging $3.62 a gallon across Wisconsin as of June 24, 2026, according to GasBuddy. AAA figures put the statewide average 12¢ lower than a week ago, 69¢ lower than a month ago, and 67¢ higher than a year ago. Drivers are finding the lowest metro average in Racine ($3.48) and the highest in Mosinee ($3.87).
